events.title: 에버턴 beat 왓퍼드 4–0 to go four points clear of 토트넘 홋스퍼, who are held to a 2–2 draw at 루턴 타운. The top four in Division Two are separated only by goal difference. 옥스퍼드 유나이티드 lead the way after winning 1–0 at 칼라일 유나이티드, displacing 블랙번 로버스 who draw 1–1 at 윔블던. 맨체스터 시티 and 버밍엄 시티 complete the quartet after away wins at 크리스털 팰리스 and 허더즈필드 타운 respectively.
Telford United, the last remaining non-league side in the FA Cup, beat 달링턴 3–0 to book a fifth round tie at 에버턴. 첼시 are shocked 3–2 at home by Third Division promotion chasers 밀월.
Mickey Thomas scores a last-minute winner as 첼시 beat 셰필드 웬즈데이 2–1 at the third time of asking in the Milk Cup quarter-final.

More bad weather hits today's fixture list with only 16 matches surviving the freeze. 맨체스터 유나이티드 are held 1–1 at 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 and miss the opportunity to make serious ground on 에버턴 and 토트넘 홋스퍼. 맨체스터 시티 also slip up in Division Two, beaten 3–1 at home by 칼라일 유나이티드.

선덜랜드 establish a 2–0 lead over 첼시 in the first leg of their Milk Cup semi-final. Two penalties by Colin West decide the match – he scores the first and converts a rebound after the second is saved by Eddie Niedzwiecki .

에버턴 end Telford United's FA Cup adventure with a 3–0 win at Goodison Park but 요크 시티 score an 86th-minute equaliser to take 리버풀 to a replay. 브래드퍼드 시티 extend their lead at the top of the Third Division to 12 points with a 2–0 win at third placed 헐 시티.
밀월 make the FA Cup quarter-finals with a 2–0 win over 레스터 시티 at The Den .
John Wark scores a hat-trick as 리버풀 register a decisive 7–0 FA Cup replay win over 요크 시티 at Anfield.

Two goals by Andy Gray – his first since September – give 에버턴 an important 2–1 win at 레스터 시티. 케니 달글리시 celebrates his 300th league appearance by scoring in 리버풀's 2–0 win over 스토크 시티. A goal by Mich d'Avray gives 입스위치 타운 a slender 1–0 advantage from the first leg of their Milk Cup semi-final against 노리치 시티.
At the foot of the Second Division, 크리스털 팰리스's relegation fears deepen as they suffer a 5–0 defeat at home to 윔블던.
레오 베인하커르 makes his debut as the manager of Dutch national team with a 7–1 win over Cyprus in Amsterdam , with two goals each from Dick Schoenaker and 빔 키프트 .
